task.goal: Turn on Wifi, then open the contacts app
task.final_summary: Wi-Fi is now on and the Contacts app is open on its Contacts tab (it shows "No contacts yet" on this device).

steps.note: Observe current screen, then open Settings/quick settings to turn on Wi-Fi
Open quick settings panel and tap the Wi-Fi tile
Expand quick settings fully to see Wi-Fi tile
Expand quick settings fully via slow swipe from top
Swipe tile pager left to find the Wi-Fi tile
Swipe to page 1 of quick settings tiles to find Wi-Fi
Open Settings app from quick settings and find Wi-Fi
Open Network & internet to check Wi-Fi state
Open the Internet page and check the Wi-Fi switch state
Turn on the Wi-Fi switch and confirm it is checked
Launch the Contacts app from the home screen or app list
Launch the Contacts app and confirm it opened
Dismiss the notification permission prompt and confirm Contacts main screen
Dismiss tooltip and confirm Contacts main screen
Dismiss remaining tooltip scrim and confirm Contacts home screen
No further steps; both tasks complete
